copy.tagline: Slide the tiles, merge the pairs, reach 2048.
copy.description: Four rows, four columns, one goal. Stack matching numbers to grow them; the game ends when the board fills up. You can keep going past 2048, the leaderboard has no ceiling.
controls: Slide every tile one way with the arrow keys or WASD.
On a touch screen, swipe to play.
The sum of each merge is added to your score.
The game ends when no moves are left.
